ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising approximately 90-95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels appearing as localized high-contrast points and clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigment field across both lobes. Distinctive high-contrast white mottling concentrated at the extreme right distal tip. Sparse, isolated high-intensity pixel clusters scattered across the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edges; the right lobe exhibits high-amplitude irregular peaks/valleys at the distal end, while the left lobe shows more consistent moderate-amplitude serration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward convex curve originating from the midline and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel cluster at the right lobe tip consistent with barnacle scarring; secondary cluster of discrete white points visible on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (light on dark) visible across the central and lateral regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the left lobe; significant irregular fragmentation and potential tissue loss at the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive X-shaped intersecting linear scars on the interior region of the left lobe.
